title: GenEOL: Harnessing the Generative Power of LLMs for Training-Free Sentence Embeddings
subcategory: training-free: aggregate embeddings of LLM-generated meaning-preserving transformations
task: Training-free sentence embeddings (STS, MTEB clustering/reranking/pair classification/classification)
problem: Training-free LLM embedding methods only optimise prompts and ignore the generative abilities of LLMs.
architecture: A generator LLM produces m diverse meaning-preserving transformations of a sentence (e.g. paraphrase, compression); an embedder LLM embeds each with an EOL-style prompt and the embeddings are averaged.
llm_or_encoder: Embedders Mistral0.1-7B, Llama2-7B, Llama3-8B; generators Mistral0.1-I-7B and ChatGPT
key_results: Mistral0.1-7B embedder with 32 transformations: STS average 79.99 vs 76.09 for MetaEOL.
Average gain of 2.85 points over prior training-free methods across LLMs on STS.
strengths: Stabilises representation quality across LLM layers and is robust to prompt perturbations.

limitations.text: Cost of generating and embedding multiple transformations per sentence.
